title: Zesty Moroccan Lentils Pasta
description: A mustardy, chewy, light Moroccan dish with raisins and al-dente pasta, nut-free-friendly and packed with flavor.
instructions: Rinse the lentils under cold water and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, ground cumin, ground coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in the lentils, raisins, and whole grain mustard, coating them in the spice mixture.
Pour in the vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta, stir, and cook uncovered for 7-8 minutes until al dente and the lentils are tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice, tasting and adjusting as needed.
Remove from heat, let rest for 2 minutes, then stir in chopped parsley if desired.
Serve hot, spooning the sauce over each portion.
